gizmo.title: Whakaharatau tātai
gizmo.description: He raupapa poto o ngā rapanga tātai kua waihangatia me te urupare inamata. Kōwhiria ngā mahi tātai me te awhe tau; he hou ia rauna.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Te ingoa o tēnei whakaharatau, ka whakaaturia ki tōna pane.

configure.title: Ngā mahi tātai
configure.description: Ko ēhea momo rapanga ka pātaia. Ka taea e ngā ākonga te whakaweto i tētahi o ēnei i mua i tā rātou tīmata.

configure.title: Tau iti rawa
configure.description: Te tau iti rawa ka whakamahia i tētahi rapanga. He tau tōpū, 0 neke atu rānei.

configure.title: Tau nui rawa
configure.description: Te tau nui rawa ka whakamahia i tētahi rapanga. Ka noho hoki ngā whakautu wehe me ngā tauwehe ki tēnei awhe.

configure.title: Te maha o ngā rapanga
configure.description: E hia ngā rapanga i te rauna kotahi (1 ki te 100).

advanced.title: Tepe wā
advanced.description: Ngā hēkona e whakaaetia ana mō te rauna katoa. Ko te 0 te tikanga kāore he matawā, koinei te taunoa: ka taka ngā ākonga e hiahia ana ki te wā roa ake i ngā whakaharatau whai matawā. Ina tautuhia, ka taea tonu e ngā ākonga te whakaweto i te matawā mō rātou anō.

advanced.title: Tae arotahi
advanced.description: Te tae o te maramara pane me ngā pātene. Waiho kia wātea hei whai i te kaupapa.
